claim_scores.rationale: Uses `lm.acall(...)` under `dspy.context(send_stream=stream, ...)`, which forces the async chat streaming branch when `send_stream` is set.
Captures `streamed_acompletion.call_args.kwargs` and asserts the streamed outbound call includes `stream=True`.
Enables `track_usage=True` on the streamed call and asserts `stream_options == {"include_usage": True}` in outbound kwargs.
Demonstrates the async streaming auth-loss behavior by asserting the streamed LiteLLM call receives `headers is None`.
Provides an offline harness with an async `send`, a mocked async iterator from `litellm.acompletion`, and a stubbed `stream_chunk_builder` so streaming completes without a backend.
Includes a second async non-stream call without `send_stream` and shows headers are preserved there, including the DSPy `User-Agent`.
